name: manual_cb16bf
claim: Optional framework compatibility needs Python-native gap errors: ModuleNotFoundError with name for unsupported modules, AttributeError for unsupported attributes, and explicit explain diagnostics when from-import replaces the reason. A finder returning None permits fallthrough; importorskip can hide a real gap. Broken installed transitive imports must propagate, never silently enable fallback.

decisions.notes: Real temporary installed-module and pytest importorskip tests in Oramasys #23 distinguish absence, unsupported symbols and broken dependencies. The no-eager-import lint checks exact typing branches, eager defaults, live lazy allowlists, all-module import tripwires and published dependency metadata. Both framework-free and pinned real-framework environments passed the relevant contracts on Python 3.12.
